sections.Overview:
Medieval mayhem. Wild battles. Big pinball energy.
Challenge the Knights of the Round Table, face Morgan le Fay and Mordred, and battle your way through a lineup of arcade-inspired medieval contests in this uproarious pinball adventure.
Legendary Edition™ is available now. Arcade Edition™ is sold out. A $2,000 deposit is required for Legendary Edition™. See reservation terms and FAQ below for details.
Plus tax and shipping/handling if applicable.

sections.Editions:
Both editions deliver the same core game. Differences are in toys, trim, presentation, and premium features.
Premium presentation, toys, topper, and upgraded details.
$2,000 deposit required. Plus tax and shipping/handling if applicable.
- • Yellow powder coat for legs and glass frame
- • Merlin figure with moving body and arms
- • Mordred and Morgan figures with glowing eyes
Same core game with streamlined toys and presentation.

- • Black powder coat for legs and glass frame

Crafted like fine furniture with quality, reliability, and serviceability treated as first-class design priorities.
- • Removable glass frame with standard-size tempered glass
- • Connectorless RGB lighting on the glass frame
- • Dual flipper buttons with Finesse Feature™
- • 13-ply 3/4" plywood cabinet with black laminate inside and out
- • UV-finished cabinet bottom and premium cabinet construction
sections.Gallery:
Cabinet, playfield, toys, and detail shots from both editions.
Welcome, brave squire, to Merlin’s Arcade! The merry wizard Merlin dares you to challenge the mightiest knights of the realm in a variety of games of skill.
- • Sir Bedivere, guardian of shuffle alley
- • Sir Dagonet, foosball player extraordinaire
But beware! Morgan le Fay and her brutish henchman Mordred have crashed the party. They will turn your noble friends into Dark Knights and steal the Holy Grail.
Can you defeat every knight, survive the duels against the forces of darkness, and rescue the Grail before Merlin decides to take you on himself?
sections.Reservation terms & FAQ:
Please review the terms and conditions for purchase and reach out with any questions before placing a deposit.
When will payment be due? + A $2,000 deposit is required immediately. Full payment, including taxes and shipping where applicable, is due within one week of notice that your machine is ready. Are deposits refundable? + Deposits are generally commitments to purchase. Deposits made directly with Turner Pinball are refundable only if your machine is not built and ready to ship within 24 months of your deposit date. Please see the full terms for complete details. How many Merlin’s Arcade™ machines will be produced? + No more than 500 Legendary Edition™ Merlin’s Arcade™ machines will be produced. Each will be numbered and include a signed Certificate of Authenticity. Arcade Edition™ machines are not numbered or limited. When will Merlin’s Arcade™ machines ship? + Legendary Edition™ machines ship before Arcade Edition™ machines. Contact us for current production timing and availability. Are deposits transferable? + No. Deposits are only valid for the original purchaser and apply only to Merlin’s Arcade™.
